name: EXIF Removal
project_description: EXIF Removal is a privacy-focused Drupal module that automatically strips embedded metadata from uploaded JPEG images. On every file entity insert it removes GPS location, camera/device make and model, capture timestamps, and other EXIF fields that could expose personal information, keeping only what is needed for correct display. The work happens transparently in a hook_file_insert() implementation, so any upload path in Drupal (node fields, user pictures, media library, etc.) is covered without configuration. Stripping is performed either with PHP's GD extension (re-encoding the JPEG with imagejpeg() at quality 80) or, when the image_effects module is installed and the ImageMagick toolkit is active, via the toolkit's 'strip' operation. Only image/jpeg files are processed; other formats are left untouched. The module ships no settings form, routes, permissions, entities, or config.
